parameters.query:
SELECT category, count(*) AS total, sum(needs_human_review) AS reviewed
FROM leads
WHERE processed_at::timestamptz >= now() - interval '7 days'
  AND COALESCE(gmail_message_id, '') NOT LIKE 'eval-%'
  AND COALESCE(gmail_message_id, '') NOT LIKE 'test-%'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY total DESC;

SELECT id, subject, summary, confidence_note
FROM leads
WHERE category = 'Unclear'
  AND processed_at::timestamptz >= now() - interval '7 days'
  AND COALESCE(gmail_message_id, '') NOT LIKE 'eval-%'
  AND COALESCE(gmail_message_id, '') NOT LIKE 'test-%'
ORDER BY processed_at;
